integrity_notes: Finite direct checks cover 61 mixed-alphabet profiles and 82,284 vertex pairs; unrestricted assertions follow from the complete probability-convolution and bisector-counting proof. No independent mathematical audit or external certification.
scientific_limitations: The theorem determines the adversarial resolving threshold and every largest nonresolving landmark set, not metric bases or the entire resolving polynomial. Equivalent formulas in unlocated literature remain possible.
title: Resolving thresholds and all largest nonresolving landmark sets in mixed Hamming graphs
